name: Mikage Yuri
source:
"[url=/c43543]Saki[/url] and I have been best friends with you two since kindergarten. So, you know, we pick up on these things."

The twins’ childhood friend and a classmate of [url=https://vndb.org/c43540]Ichika'[/url], Yuri is the easygoing, freewheeling sort, though her jokes make her sound like a dirty old man.

She enjoys ogling girls' panties and takes great pride in her role helping along the development of Saki's breasts. Gifted with keen intuition, Yuri is always there for her friends when they need her, even if they themselves don’t know it.

She’s a smart girl, but she conks out after the slightest bit of exercise. Yuri is a member of the literature club and something of an otaku.

Yuri is the darling of their all-girls school, especially to the underclassmen, and often finds love letters in her locker. She enjoys--no, she revels in being so popular.

[From [url=https://www.mangagamer.com/detail.php?product_code=1074]MangaGamer[/url]]
